topics.title: Hurricane Trudy strengthens off Mexico
topics.summary: Hurricane Trudy intensified into a Category 3 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast. Forecasters said it was heading toward southwestern and west-central parts of the country, putting seasonal preparedness back in focus.
topics.discussionPrompt: When storm season starts making headlines, what’s your go-to comfort strategy: checking every forecast, stocking snacks, or pretending the weather app is being dramatic?

topics.title: Fed chair emphasizes price stability
topics.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said price stability remains central to the Fed’s work, while declining to signal what policymakers may do at their October and December meetings.
topics.discussionPrompt: Interest-rate talk can sound abstract—what makes the economy feel real to you: rent, groceries, a loan payment, or something completely different?

topics.title: Tech shares keep markets on edge
topics.summary: U.S. stock futures were subdued as technology shares faced fresh pressure over concerns about the AI trade. Tesla gains and lower oil prices provided some counterweight before the market opened.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you had to pick one future-facing industry to follow for fun, would it be AI, electric cars, space, clean energy, or something stranger?

topics.title: Tesla unveils a dramatic Roadster concept
topics.summary: Tesla showcased a redesigned Roadster that it says uses SpaceX-style thrusters, drawing attention for a demonstration involving a ramp, flight, flip and landing.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather own a wildly futuristic car with a few party tricks, or a wonderfully boring one that never needs attention?

topics.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open
topics.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model it says can handle multi-step reasoning and complex software engineering as it competes with Chinese AI rivals.
topics.discussionPrompt: If an AI could handle one tedious task around your home or work, what would you happily hand over first?

topics.title: Dodo revival project reports progress
topics.summary: A U.S. biotech company says it has made progress toward its long-term goal of bringing back the extinct dodo and returning it to Mauritius, where the bird disappeared centuries ago.
topics.discussionPrompt: If science could bring back one extinct animal, would you choose a dodo, mammoth, passenger pigeon, or leave the past alone?

topics.title: Gobi dinosaur museum opens in a harsh landscape
topics.summary: Architects have built a pterosaur museum in China’s Gobi desert near fossil discoveries, designing it to work with the demanding environment while supporting research and visitors.
topics.discussionPrompt: What kind of museum could tempt you into a long trip: dinosaurs, old machines, movie props, strange local history, or something hands-on?

topics.title: Spain’s Poncelet sets downhill skateboard record
topics.summary: Spanish downhill skateboarder Diego Poncelet set a world speed record of 151.83 kph in Canada, surpassing the previous mark on the same road after years of chasing it.
topics.discussionPrompt: What sounds more thrilling to watch than try yourself: downhill skating, skydiving, racing, surfing giant waves, or something else?

topics.title: Indonesia wildfire haze reaches Singapore
topics.summary: Smoke from Indonesia’s severe wildfire season pushed Singapore’s air pollution to a yearly high, while parts of East Timor and Malaysia adjusted school plans amid the haze.
topics.discussionPrompt: When air quality or weather changes your plans, do you adapt quickly, get annoyed, or use it as an excuse for an unexpectedly cozy day indoors?

topics.title: Fall foliage draws crowds and cameras
topics.summary: Autumn’s vivid colors are spreading across the American landscape, with seasonal scenery becoming a bright counterpoint to the usual daily rush and a popular reason to head outdoors.
topics.discussionPrompt: Are you someone who plans a fall drive for the colors, or do you only notice the leaves when they start covering your doorstep?
